quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: You must let go of the illusion of control.
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: You can chain my body, but you will never chain my warrior spirit!
quotes.author: Crane

quotes.text: Oogway made a mistake choosing you as the Dragon Warrior. I just didn't realize how big a mistake it was until now.
quotes.author: Tai Lung

quotes.text: You are ready. I've never been more sure of anything.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: I'm not trying to turn you into me. I'm trying to turn you into you.
quotes.author: Master Shifu

quotes.text: Now, who wants to do the right thing for the wrong reasons?
quotes.author: Zhen

quotes.text: I too came from humble beginnings.
quotes.author: The Chameleon

quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: The secret ingredient is... nothing! To make something special you just have to believe it's special.
quotes.author: Mr. Ping
